sectionPath: 7.1 PCIM Actors, Transactions, and Content Modules

requirements.normativeText:
To claim compliance with the PCIM Profile, an actor shall support every
transaction listed as required for that actor in Table 7.1-1.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting the implementation conformance claim for the PCIM actor and
confirming support for all required transactions in Table 7.1-1.

sectionPath: 7.1 PCIM Actors, Transactions, and Content Modules
7.1.1 Actor Descriptions and Actor Profile Requirements

requirements.normativeText:
The Device-Patient Association Reporter shall report the patient identifier,
device identifier, and beginning or ending timestamp for each association or
disassociation event that it asserts.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting DEV-51 messages originated by the Device-Patient Association
Reporter and confirming that the patient, device, and timestamp content is present.

sectionPath: 7.1 PCIM Actors, Transactions, and Content Modules
7.1.1 Actor Descriptions and Actor Profile Requirements

requirements.normativeText:
The Device-Patient Association Reporter shall mark validated reports as final
and shall mark non-validated reports as requiring validation.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting OBX-11 in DEV-51 messages originated by the Device-Patient
Association Reporter.

sectionPath: 7.1 PCIM Actors, Transactions, and Content Modules
7.1.1 Actor Descriptions and Actor Profile Requirements

requirements.normativeText:
The Device-Patient Association Manager shall communicate validated
device-patient associations as event notifications.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting DEV-52 messages originated by the Device-Patient Association
Manager after association validation.

sectionPath: 7.1 PCIM Actors, Transactions, and Content Modules
7.1.1 Actor Descriptions and Actor Profile Requirements

requirements.normativeText:
The Device-Patient Association Manager shall provide an HMI for validating
association assertions that require validation and for resolving conflicts.

verification.text:
Verify by inspection or demonstration of the Device-Patient Association Manager
validation and conflict-resolution HMI.

requirements.normativeText:
A Device-Patient Association Consumer that supports the Subscription and
Filtering Option shall formulate its filtering request as specified in Section
3.19.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting DEV-19 messages originated by a Device-Patient Association
Consumer that claims the Subscription and Filtering Option.

requirements.normativeText:
The Device-Patient Association Manager may support the Subscription and
Filtering Option.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting the implementation conformance claim for the Device-Patient
Association Manager and, when the option is claimed, by executing DEV-19 tests.

requirements.normativeText:
When verification occurs at the Device-Patient Association Reporter, the
Reporter shall record the responsible observer.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting a DEV-51 message for the responsible observer information
when the assertion is sent as already verified.

requirements.normativeText:
The Device-Patient Association Reporter shall include an observation status
field indicating whether the assertion requires validation or is final.

verification.text: Verify by inspecting OBX-11 in DEV-51 messages originated by the Reporter.

requirements.normativeText:
The Device-Patient Association Manager shall provide an HMI to verify
association and disassociation assertions received through DEV-51.

verification.text:
Verify by inspection or demonstration of the Manager HMI for DEV-51 validation
workflow.

requirements.normativeText:
The patient identifier used in a DEV-51 message shall include the identifier
type and issuing entity.

verification.text: Verify by inspecting PID-3 in DEV-51 messages originated by the Reporter.

requirements.normativeText:
DEV-51 correction messages shall reference the association unique instance
identifier from the original message in OBR-29.2.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting OBR-29.2 in DEV-51 correction messages and confirming it
matches OBR-3 from the original association message.

requirements.normativeText:
The device identifier and association unique instance identifier shall not be
changed in a DEV-51 correction message.

verification.text:
Verify by comparing the device identifier and association unique instance
identifier in a DEV-51 correction message with the original association message.

requirements.normativeText:
DEV-51 messages asserting an existing device-patient association as wrong shall
reference in OBR-29.2 the association unique instance identifier from OBR-3 of
the original association message.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting OBR-29.2 in DEV-51 wrong-association messages and confirming
it matches OBR-3 from the original association message.

requirements.normativeText:
The Device-Patient Association Manager shall send current associations for all
devices that the Consumer is configured to receive reports for immediately after
a connection is established.

verification.text:
Verify by establishing a Manager-to-Consumer connection and confirming that
current matching associations are sent as DEV-52 messages.

requirements.normativeText:
When a DEV-52 association report is successfully received, the Device-Patient
Association Consumer shall return a commit-level accept acknowledgement to the
Device-Patient Association Manager.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting the acknowledgement returned by the Consumer after receipt
of a valid DEV-52 message.

requirements.normativeText:
The Device-Patient Association Manager shall send DEV-52 messages to all
configured Device-Patient Association Consumer instances with matching filter
criteria.

verification.text:
Verify by configuring one or more Consumers and confirming that each matching
Consumer receives the applicable DEV-52 message.

requirements.normativeText:
The Device-Patient Association Manager shall send correction reports to
Device-Patient Association Consumers when the corrections are validated.

verification.text:
Verify by validating a correction at the Manager and confirming that the
corresponding DEV-52 correction report is sent to applicable Consumers.

requirements.normativeText:
DEV-52 messages reporting an existing device-patient association as wrong shall
reference in OBR-29.2 the association unique instance identifier from OBR-3 of
the original association message.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting OBR-29.2 in DEV-52 wrong-association messages and confirming
it matches OBR-3 from the original association message.

requirements.normativeText:
A Device-Patient Association Consumer that is also a device data reporter actor
shall stop including the wrong patient identifier in outgoing messages as soon
as it receives the wrong-association report.

verification.text:
Verify by sending a DEV-52 wrong-association report to the Consumer and
confirming subsequent outgoing device data messages no longer include the wrong
patient identifier.

requirements.normativeText:
When a DEV-19 message is accepted by the Device-Patient Association Manager, the
accept acknowledgement shall contain the value `CA` in MSA-1.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting MSA-1 in the acknowledgement returned by the Manager for an
accepted DEV-19 message.

requirements.normativeText:
When DEV-19 is not supported, the Device-Patient Association Manager shall return
an acknowledgement with `CR` in MSA-1, `200` in ERR-3, and `E` in ERR-4.

verification.text:
Verify by sending a DEV-19 message to a Manager that does not support DEV-19 and
inspecting the returned acknowledgement.

requirements.normativeText:
If DEV-19 is not supported and network connectivity between the Device-Patient
Association Manager and Device-Patient Association Consumer is restored after a
loss of connection, the Manager shall send DEV-52 messages for all current
device-patient associations to the Consumer.

verification.text:
Verify by restoring a lost Manager-to-Consumer connection when DEV-19 is not
supported and confirming that current associations are sent as DEV-52 messages.

sectionPath: A.2.3 Details of Device-Patient Association Query Message [DEV-19]

requirements.normativeText: The QueryTag in QPD.2 shall be unique for each DEV-19 query.

verification.text: Verify by inspecting QPD.2 values in DEV-19 queries originated by the Consumer.

sectionPath: A.2.3 Details of Device-Patient Association Query Message [DEV-19]

requirements.normativeText:
If multiple DEV-19 query parameter specifications are present, QSC.4 shall
specify the relational conjunction except for the last specification.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting QSC.4 values in DEV-19 queries that contain multiple query
parameter specifications.

requirements.normativeText:
A Device-Patient Association Consumer that uses DEV-19 shall support receiving a
continuous real-time feed of association events and shall receive existing
associations matching the filter specification when the connection is first
established.

verification.text:
Verify by establishing a filtered subscription and confirming that the Consumer
receives both the initial matching association state and subsequent real-time
updates.

sectionPath: A.1 Communicate and Report Association State

requirements.normativeText:
DEV-51 and DEV-52 messages shall value MSH-21 with the appropriate PCIM message
profile identifier for the transaction.

verification.text: Verify by inspecting MSH-21 in DEV-51 and DEV-52 ORU_R01 messages.

sectionPath: A.1 Communicate and Report Association State

requirements.normativeText:
DEV-51 and DEV-52 messages shall be constrained to reporting associations for a
single patient and device.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting each DEV-51 or DEV-52 ORU_R01 message and confirming that it
reports only one patient-device association.

sectionPath: A.1 Communicate and Report Association State

requirements.normativeText: MSH-15 in DEV-51 and DEV-52 messages shall be set to `AL`.

verification.text: Verify by inspecting MSH-15 in DEV-51 and DEV-52 ORU_R01 messages.

sectionPath: A.1 Communicate and Report Association State

requirements.normativeText:
DEV-51 and DEV-52 messages shall include a PID segment to identify the patient
associated with the device.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting DEV-51 and DEV-52 ORU_R01 messages and confirming the PID
segment is present.

sectionPath: A.1 Communicate and Report Association State

requirements.normativeText:
The Patient Identifier List in PID-3 shall contain an identifier that is unique
for all patients within the scope of the system.

verification.text: Verify by inspecting PID-3 in DEV-51 and DEV-52 ORU_R01 messages.

sectionPath: A.1 Communicate and Report Association State

requirements.normativeText:
OBR-3 in DEV-51 and DEV-52 messages shall contain a unique association event
instance identifier generated so that duplicate identifiers between sources are
not possible.

verification.text:
Verify by inspecting OBR-3 values in DEV-51 and DEV-52 ORU_R01 messages and
confirming uniqueness across message sources.

sectionPath: A.1 Communicate and Report Association State

requirements.normativeText:
DEV-51 and DEV-52 association or disassociation event reports shall include in
OBR-7 the earliest participant involvement timestamp and in OBR-8 the latest
participant involvement timestamp.

verification.text:
Verify by comparing OBR-7 and OBR-8 with PRT-11 and PRT-12 timestamps in the
same DEV-51 or DEV-52 message.
